SELECT 
    STG.SET_ID
    ,SET_DESC
    ,LCHG_USER_ID
    ,CONVERT(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) LCHG_TIME
    ,RCRE_USER_ID
    ,CONVERT(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) RCRE_TIME
    ,TS_CNT
    ,STG.BANK_ID
    ,ALT1_SET_DESC
    ,RSIS_ALIAS
    ,1 as isActive
    ,1 as isLatest
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,convert(date,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM BUSC.DEP_SETIDTABLE_DELTA DELTA
LEFT JOIN d360.STG_DEP_SETIDTABLE STG
    ON DELTA.SET_ID = STG.SET_ID
    AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID
WHERE H = 'D'

    ,[TS_CNT]

    AND SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
 WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
    SCHM_CODE
    ,SRL_NUM
    ,DEL_FLG
    ,FLOW_CODE
    ,CONVERT(INT,FLOW_FREQ_MTHS) AS FLOW_FREQ_MTHS
    ,CONVERT(INT,FLOW_FREQ_DAYS) AS FLOW_FREQ_DAYS
    ,FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND
    ,FLOW_PERD_END_IND
    ,LCHG_USER_ID
    ,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
    ,RCRE_USER_ID
    ,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
    ,CONVERT(INT,TS_CNT) AS TS_CNT
    ,BANK_ID
    ,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,INSERT_DTTM) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM d360.STG_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE
WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
    CAL_B2K_TYPE
    ,CAL_B2K_ID
    ,MMYYYY
    ,BANK_ID
    ,DEL_FLG
    ,HLDY_STR
    ,COMMENT_STR
    ,RECVD_STR
    ,STATUS
    ,LCHG_USER_ID
    ,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
    ,RCRE_USER_ID
    ,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
    ,TS_CNT
    ,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,INSERT_DTTM) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM d360.STG_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE
WHERE H = 'D'
